name: navidrome
title: Navidrome
description: Navidrome streams your music collection to the browser and to any Subsonic app (Symfonium, play:Sub, DSub, Ultrasonic…). Point it at the folder with your files; the first account you create is the admin.

variables.name: MUSIC_PATH
variables.label: Music folder
variables.description: Host directory with your music (read-only inside the container)

variables.name: NAVIDROME_SCAN_SCHEDULE
variables.label: Library scan interval
variables.description: How often to look for new files (Go duration, e.g. 30m, 6h, 0 to disable)
